# The Princesses Armoire

> A vintage and designer women's clothing closet run by Melinda, a seamstress in Oviedo, Florida, near Orlando. It sells one-of-a-kind pieces on Poshmark, Depop and Etsy, and offers alterations and custom designs.

## What it sells
- Vintage dresses: Edwardian lace, 1950s tulle and cocktail dresses, Gunne Sax and Jessica McClintock.
- Tops, skirts, shoes and accessories, including crowns and tiaras.
- Custom-made sequin maxi skirts, made to size, in colors such as aqua, violet, gold, silver and rose gold.
- Designer brands seen in the closet: Badgley Mischka, Ulla Johnson, Reformation, Free People, Lilly Pulitzer, UGG, Coach.

## How to buy
- Shop the closet on Poshmark: https://poshmark.com/closet/the_armoire
- Buy directly from the seller and save 10%: use the "Save now" form on https://theprincessesarmoire.com/#direct
- Bundle 4 or more pieces on Poshmark for 15% off.

## Seamstress services
- Custom designs, wedding dress alterations, hemming, mending and take-ins in the Orlando, Florida area.
- Ask through the "Ask about alterations" form on https://theprincessesarmoire.com/

## Facts
- Selling since 2018.
- About 139,000 followers on Poshmark.
- Rated 4.9 out of 5 stars on Depop.
